```lean
intro v
obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := v
have h1 : p ≠ 0 := by contradiction hp
have h2 : Ideal.isPrime p := by apply IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.isPrime v
have h3 : Ideal.isMaximal p := by apply IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.isMaximal v
have h4 : Ideal.absNorm p = Ideal.idealAbsNorm p := by rfl
have h5 : Ideal.idealAbsNorm p = (Ideal.idealNorm p).abs := by rfl
have h6 : Ideal.idealNorm p = 1 ∨ Ideal.idealNorm p = -1 := by apply IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.idealNorm v
cases h6 with h7 h8
exact absurd h7 h1
exact absurd h8 h1
```
